summary: Dashboard conditional series disappear when tracehook parameter contains colon ':'
description: Issue summary: Several dashboard tiles with conditional series filters stop returning series when the tracehook parameter (trace_param) passed in the URL contains a colon character (":"). Impact: Customer sees missing series and alerts not firing for the affected dashboards; production analytics and SLOs for one product team are undercounted. Environment: prod us-west, console v3.2.1, front-end static assets hashed at build 2026-03-08. Steps to reproduce: 1) Create dashboard with a conditional series: filter where metadata.trace_id startsWith {{tracehook.trace_param}} 2) Generate a tracehook link that injects a trace_param containing a colon (example: trace=org:service-1234) 3) Open the dashboard via the tracehook link 4) Observe that the conditional series panel either shows empty series or the series is removed from legend Expected behaviour: series should render and alert evaluation should consider the injected param. Observed behaviour: series vanish and alert evaluation returns no-data. Logs & evidence: console frontend logs show a URL-decoding path where downstream query builder treats colon as namespace separator and strips trailing text. Backend query planner logs show a malformed groupby expression and a subsequent empty index lookup for the affected route. Attaching traces: user-provided screenshot and a short screen capture of the dashboard render are linked in the issue attachments. Reproducibility: reliably reproduced with any tracehook parameter containing a colon; ampersand/percent encodings behave differently depending on client encoding.

investigation_notes: Hypothesis A: Frontend URL parsing decodes tracehook param then hands raw string to query-builder without escaping special characters, leading to parser treating ':' as namespace separator.
Hypothesis B: The conditional-series normalization logic strips characters after ':' when matching metric keys due to legacy support for namespaced attributes (org:service).

Data gathered: Repro script executed against prod query-builder shows that tracehook values containing ':' produce a filter token "metadata.trace_id startsWith org" and drop the remainder "service-1234". Escaping with %3A preserves full token.
Related systems checked: no changes to alert evaluator; retention-rollup job did not touch query-builder code, but frontend build 2026-03-08 introduced updated tracehook parsing utility (PR #1489).
Correlation: Linked to SUP-271314 (policy-anchored-alerts) which had reported param normalization problems during org-id migrations.
resolution_notes: Workaround provided (2026-03-12): Customers can URL-encode colon characters in tracehook parameters (replace ':' with '%3A') to preserve conditional series. Communicated to AcmeHealth.

Fix plan: Patch in console query-builder to treat tracehook values as literal strings and escape special characters before tokenization. Small fix prepared in branch fix/tracehook-colon-escape. Target hotfix release: 2026-03-15 (console v3.2.2-hotfix).

Rollout notes: Hotfix will be rolled to us-west first and monitored for 2 hours. Post-deploy runbook to verify: reproduce sample tracehook link, confirm conditional series render, run alert evals for affected dashboards. If stable, rollout across regions.

Follow-ups: 1) Add unit tests for tracehook param edge cases (colons, slashes, unicode). 2) Add e2e test that opens dashboards via tracehook links and verifies series presence. 3) Add note to retention-rollup postmortem to check for inadvertent coupling with tracehook parsing utilities.
Status: Patch merged to hotfix branch, integration tests in progress. Customer notified and will validate after hotfix deploy.
